description.zh: 把窗口变成点击穿透：鼠标点过去落到下面的窗口，同时按设置变淡；再次触发或退出时恢复（复刻 AltSnap 的 ClickThrough）
description.en: Make a window click-through: clicks fall to the window below, dimmed by the setting; toggle again or exit to restore (AltSnap's ClickThrough)

hint.zh: 默认 85，明显变淡（不透明度约 15%）；0 不变淡，100 完全看不见
hint.en: Default 85: clearly faded (about 15% opaque); 0 keeps it solid, 100 makes it invisible

hint.zh: 默认 F2；按下时穿透/恢复前台窗口（可在「快捷键作用于鼠标下的窗口」里改为鼠标下的窗口），留空则不注册
hint.en: Default F2; pressing it toggles the foreground window (change it to the window under the mouse with the setting below), empty registers nothing

hint.zh: 留空不注册；按下只恢复当前穿透窗口，不会对其他窗口开启穿透
hint.en: Empty registers nothing; it only restores the current click-through window

title.en: Show a footer notice on toggles

hint.zh: 用快捷键穿透/恢复时显示一行提示
hint.en: Show a line when the hotkey applies or restores

title.zh: 快捷键作用于鼠标下的窗口
title.en: The hotkey uses the window under the mouse

hint.zh: 默认关，和 AltSnap 的 UsePtWindow=0 一致：快捷键作用于前台窗口；打开后改用鼠标下的窗口
hint.en: Off by default, like AltSnap's UsePtWindow=0: the hotkey uses the foreground window; turn on to use the window under the mouse

description.zh: 列出窗口；Enter 让选中窗口点击穿透或恢复，Ctrl+Enter 恢复当前穿透的窗口
description.en: List windows; Enter toggles click-through on one, Ctrl+Enter restores the one that is click-through

hint.zh: 窗口或程序名的一部分；留空列出全部
hint.en: part of a window or program name; empty lists all

ai.description: List top-level windows with a title (window title and program). Read-only; it does not change any window. Use the action tool to toggle click-through only when the user asks.
